text: Students investigated differences in weather in a city centre square. Fig. 1.1 (Insert) shows the
square which is pedestrianised. They identified five sites in the square where they could measure
temperature, wind direction and wind speed at midday (12:00 hours) and in the early evening on
The students investigated the following hypotheses:
Hypothesis 1: Midday temperatures are higher at sites A, B and C than at sites D and E.
Hypothesis 2: Wind direction and wind speed vary more at site C than at site E.

speed vary between the sites in the city centre square.
